note: Every $defs.outcome id maps to exactly one of the 6 spec variants. Identity rows are the 6 variants themselves (canonical snake). Specialization rows are finer operational terminals that fold into a variant. No row is unmapped in this reconstruction.

rows.why: A release gate is a bound decision, not a no-decision.
A closed finding table is the decided record.
Closing a live session is an affirmative decision to stop work.
A named containment act is a bound decision.
An evidenced causal record is the decided account of cause.
A recommendation is a decided preferred option presented to the owner.
A generative run's decided output is the idea set, not a no-decision.
May-we / must-not is a bound ruling.
A scored forecast is a decision under stated conditions, not a bind.
Referral upward is the council not deciding; distinct from a hard-cap artifact which CNL-0096 still distinguishes at this 17-value grain.
